items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 15 at 1:47PM EST until November 18 at 1:00PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 25 knots with gusts up to 30
knots and seas 7 to 10 feet expected.

* WHERE...Portions of Atlantic coastal waters.

* WHEN...From 1 PM Monday to at least 1 PM EST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
